name: umbraco-setup
title: Umbraco Setup (add-on)
description: Umbraco-specific tasks layered on top of standard-delivery. Its task lists share the same names, so applying it after standard-delivery adds these tasks to the existing lists rather than creating duplicates.

variables.name: domain_name
variables.description: The project's primary domain name, e.g. example.com

tasks.title: Client CMS training & handover
tasks.description: Train the customer's editors on Umbraco, hand over credentials and documentation, and confirm who to contact for support.
